items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Joshua didn't try. Because I don't know what I'm going to make on it myself until I make it.

ctx.x: Oh, that Joe Everest piece you made that up? That was my number.

We made that number up during the other time. We was playing a few of them called them. And I made, that's the first time I made that hoop on the base. And Joe looked at me and said, you got something new? He said, well you learned that. I said, that's all right. He said, well what you don't name that? I said, I'm going to name it after you. I'm going to call it Everest Boogie. But it should have been named Tillman Boogie because then nobody knows nothing about it. And they had a bass player in the whole city of…
Your style just comes to you. That's right.
